an6.118:1.1: Cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo ajjhattaṃ kāye . . . pe . . .
an6.118:1.14: Kammārāmataṃ, bhassārāmataṃ, niddārāmataṃ, saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ, indriyesu aguttadvārataṃ, bhojane amattaññutaṃ . . .
an6.118:1.15: Ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo ajjhattabahiddhā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharitun
